q.g: In this quest you have to obtain Thirsty's battered diary in the basement of the health resort west wing on Shoreline. It can be found in a room near the pool. There are multiple spawns throughout the room.

sh.c: Health resort west wing location marked on map
Room location marked on west wing basement map
First spawn on the floor next to the trashcan directly left after entering
Second spawn inside the left drawer in the fridge
Third spawn in the red box attached to the blue locker
